notes.title: Thank You for Being a Part of NPCville’s Limited-Time Demo!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We’re absolutely thrilled that you’ve shown interest in NPCville and dedicated your time to playing our limited Gamescom demo. Your feedback means the world to us, and we’re genuinely grateful for your support.

We’ve made the decision during this time to remove the demo so we can incorporate your feedback as we strive to make NPCville even more exciting and immersive. We will share our progress with you in future announcements.

Once again, thank you for being a part of this journey with us. Your support means everything, and we can’t wait to bring you more of Aimee’s adventure in the world of NPCville!

Stay proud to be an NPC!
Warm regards,

Ginvo Studio.

notes.title: NPCVille Announcement at Indie Arena Booth 2023 Gamescom Recap!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513550/efb321afbf8af85099ff4bc0af9fe1e4f408b2ca.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone!
A lot of you played our first public demo of NPCVille at the Indie Arena Booth during Gamescom in Cologne, Germany. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513550/7eef683c3e9764c904ea94239b07f7a3a29d7fd7.jpg[/img]
We are really glad that we had good receptions from all the community who tried the game and brought back their friends and family and introduced them to our booth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513550/66023332101faab4d75fc60a3155e7b9d95b83bb.jpg[/img]
Thank you so much for all the good feedback from all of you about our current demo, we definitely would note it all down and would improve the game to be better as soon as possible. Special thanks to @eveque67 for all the feedback on the discussion forum, we are grateful that you took your time to push our game to be much better, we will post an update on game as soon as possible.

Let me know about your experience in the discussion of this event! 

Thank you for all the support, Stay proud to be an NPC!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513550/7a67ef9e83e22d52c39a934d29f12591ad463547.png[/img]
